glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 网 (“net”) + 貝 (“money cowrie”). The original version is 𧵽. Baxter and Sagart (2014) consider it to be a phono-semantic compound (形聲): abbreviated phonetic 羅 + semantic 貝 (“money cowrie”).
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 買; s_page_origin explains the simplified 买.
